about: Which scenario collections the demo may serve, and on what terms. The public site (server.py --public) serves only collections marked public here, and only WAV files whose SHA-256 is listed under public_wav_sha256.

collections.title: Competition development set
collections.kind: Original kit recordings (AI-generated Gemini TTS voices, procedural noise)
collections.description: The 24 development calls supplied with the SARJ starter kit.
collections.rights: Supplied to participants; the kit grants no public redistribution licence. The owner's approval covers the private repository and local team use only. Never served by the public site.

collections.title: Phase 3 constructed scenarios: xdev
collections.description: 25 scenarios assembled from recordings of real people reading isolated Arabic keywords and from licensed non-speech sound clips, mixed digitally (not spontaneous conversations). Used while developing Phase 3.
collections.rights: ASC voice clips CC BY 4.0; ESC-50 sound clips individually CC0 or CC BY (Freesound), cross-checked against the ESC-50 LICENSE file; generated room tone, echo and filters. Redistributable with attribution.

collections.title: Phase 3 constructed scenarios: holdout
collections.description: 25 scenarios built the same way with different speakers and sound clips, kept frozen during Phase 3 and scored once. Shown here for listening only; never used to tune the detector.
collections.rights: Same sources and licences as xdev (different speakers and clips).

attribution.by: Abdulkader Ghandoura, Farouk Hjabo, Oumayma Al Dakkak
attribution.cite: Building and Benchmarking an Arabic Speech Commands Dataset for Small-Footprint Keyword Spotting, Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, 2021
attribution.changes: One-second keyword clips trimmed, level-scaled, concatenated, filtered and mixed with other sounds.

attribution.work: ESC-50: Dataset for Environmental Sound Classification
attribution.license: Only clips whose own Freesound licence is CC0 or CC BY are used (per clip, below). The compilation as a whole is CC BY-NC 3.0; this demo is non-commercial.
attribution.changes: Clips cut, level-scaled, filtered and mixed into the caller channel.

attribution.work: Silero VAD v6 (model used by the P3 detector)
